result: For this series of screenshots, you will analyze one by one and you will notice that on the left there is the Z implementation of the GitD viewer side-by-side version JetBrains with some discrepancies. and on the right there is actually the same screenshot for the same file visualized through IntelliJ but of course what I want you to do is to really deep dive on each screen that you will go one by one and find what is needed, what is missing, what has to be altered in order to fix the behavior in the right panel. I pretty much want to have more or less the same on both but I don't want to break things also you will notice that The order of the files in the left panel is actually not the right one. I would expect to have the same order than on the current app, if it's copied from the backup folder. So can you please put all this together so that I can try to implement the missing stuff in a huge signal prompt that will one-shot this problem, even if it's one by one.
